notes: Partition verified: all 21 source ids and all 32 target ids occur exactly once. The only unrepresented units are s008 (the לְ of לֵאמֹר, rule 27) and s014 (the waw before אִישׁ, for which the ASV writes no connective, rule 14); nothing is added.

s010 rightly carries the whole causative frame *Cause ye … to draw near* (rules 17, 44, discontinuous under rule 25), headed on the lexeme-bearing *draw*, since *cause* alone causes anything. The margin's *Or, Draw ye near* is an alternative rendering and does not touch the units of the printed text (rule 38).

s013 takes *over* as the construct relation recast with a preposition, which rule 19 names explicitly, while the present article s012 takes the *the* standing before its own word *city* (rule 29). The construct פְּקֻדּוֹת keeps only *them that have charge*, headed on *charge* by rule 31's subtraction.

The *with* before *a loud voice* and the *with* before *his destroying weapon* are both licensed by the adverbial accusative under rule 33 and are not added; the *a* goes to the nominal expression under rule 15.
